pages.title: Acox
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Acox sends a character through platform levels with crystals to collect. Run, jump and climb to reach the full set, which opens the portal onward. Find a route through the terrain that brings you back to the unlocked exit.

pages.title: 2 Player Games Design Salon
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: 2 Player Games Design Salon turns artistic tasks into a real-time contest. Click and drag to complete the design requested in each round while another player works on the same challenge. Compare the results as the competition introduces another creative assignment.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe - Match Three
pages.creator: takemesomewherenice
pages.description: Tic Tac Toe Match Three asks you to place your symbol on a board and form a line of three. Watch the opponent's placements and block an approaching winning line. Choose each space to advance your own combination without leaving an easy opening.

pages.title: Forest Survivor Rougelike
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Forest Survivor Rougelike puts a fighter into a forest filled with attacking enemies. Move to dodge their attacks and defeat them for experience. Each level-up offers random skills that improve damage, range, speed or other abilities for the next encounter.

pages.title: Gift Merge Santa World Tour
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Gift Merge Santa World Tour asks you to generate presents and combine identical ones into new toys. Fulfill children's wishes to increase a country's happiness and unlock another destination. Keep developing the gift collection as Santa travels around the world.

pages.title: Capybara Coin Master
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Capybara Coin Master begins with buying a coin and flipping it for income when heads appears. Use the earnings to improve the coins and hire capybaras to automate the flipping. Develop Coin Mastery to strengthen the team's income-generating abilities.

pages.title: Screamals
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Screamals asks you to change a character's shape to fit through approaching obstacles. Drag up or down to alter its proportions and line up with the available opening. Collect musical notes along the route and use them against the boss.

pages.title: Port Shipping Tycoon
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Port Shipping Tycoon turns tile flipping into the growth of a shipping business. Click tiles to supply resources and develop ports around the world. Keep expanding the operation as the next set of tiles offers another way to support the network.

pages.title: Strongblade
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Strongblade combines matching puzzles with developing a fantasy campsite. Match at least three colored items to complete level objectives and work around barriers such as stones, chains or webs. Use boosters and quest rewards to keep improving the camp.

pages.title: Homo Evolution
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Homo Evolution lets you guide a fictional world by merging creatures into more advanced forms. Explore branching stages from small lifeforms toward new civilizations and planets. Combine the final creatures in a stage to open the next part of the evolution path.

pages.title: Cute Relaxing Matching 3 Tiles
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Cute Relaxing Matching 3 Tiles gives you farm-themed pieces to match. Find identical tiles and bring three together to clear a group. Keep examining the arrangement as each completed combination opens another part of the puzzle.

pages.title: Block Craft 3D School
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Block Craft 3D School combines block building with protecting a school. Gather and place different blocks to develop the structure while keeping watch for enemies nearby. Continue shaping the pixel-style surroundings without leaving the school exposed to attackers.

pages.title: Kitchen Sorting
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Kitchen Sorting asks you to organize ingredients into glass jars before pouring them into a cooking pot. Move the top group onto ingredients of the same kind or into an empty jar. Separate every jar correctly to finish the level and prepare the meal.

pages.title: Candy Shop Merge
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Candy Shop Merge turns pairs of identical sweets into new recipes. Keep combining the candies to unlock more varieties and expand the board. Click for faster production or let the business progress while building a larger collection of treats.

pages.title: Monster Girls High School Squad
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Monster Girls High School Squad lets you create outfits for supernatural students. Mix clothing with magical accessories and choose a distinct look for each character. Explore the wardrobe to complete the squad's new styles.

pages.title: Adventures Thomas: Draw and Erase
pages.creator: Merson
pages.description: Adventures Thomas Draw and Erase uses two tools to help Thomas collect stars and reach the finish. Draw a road around gaps or erase obstacles blocking the way. Prepare the route before pressing Start, keeping the limited attempts in mind.

pages.title: Muscle Man Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Muscle Man Rush turns a running course into a boxing-themed strength challenge. Move along the route and use the fighter's punches to work past opposition. Build the character's level and prepare for the boss waiting at the end.

pages.title: Word Swipe
pages.creator: DAPALAB
pages.description: Word Swipe asks you to solve hidden words by moving letter blocks. Read yellow letters as belonging somewhere in the answer and green ones as already correctly placed. Keep adjusting the arrangement until you identify the word required for the level.

pages.title: Tripeaks Solitaire
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Tripeaks Solitaire asks you to clear exposed cards that are one rank above or below the open card. Draw from the closed stack when no useful play remains. Choose classic play or work through the collection of individual layouts.

pages.title: Throwing Knife
pages.creator: happyGames
pages.description: Throwing Knife is an arcade challenge where firing the blade drives your progress upward. Click to make a throw and keep climbing through the play area. Judge the next shot as you try to continue the attempt.

pages.title: Ball Climb
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Ball Climb asks you to switch a ball between the left and right sides of a wall to avoid obstacles. Watch the next hazard and choose the clear side before reaching it. Keep climbing to improve the score for the run.

pages.title: Stickman That One Level
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Stickman That One Level traps a stickman in a room with spikes, platforms, a key and an exit. Move and jump around the hazards while working out the puzzle that lets him escape. Use the room's details to find a way through.

pages.title: Alien Home Block collapse
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Alien Home Block Collapse asks you to clear star blocks from a stranded UFO's route. Remove the right parts of the arrangement so the craft can reach its home planet. Plan how each collapse changes the remaining path before selecting another block.

pages.title: Air Hockey Multi player
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Air Hockey Multi Player puts two players across a table with a puck to contest. Move the blue paddle and send the puck toward the opposing goal while guarding your own. The first side to score three goals wins the match.

pages.title: Hero Tower Wars Online
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Hero Tower Wars Online sends a hero through enemy towers to rescue a princess. Choose the next floor by calculating how its numbers affect your strength through addition, subtraction or multiplication. Collect useful objects and coins while working toward the rescue.

pages.title: Easter Funny Makeup
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Easter Funny Makeup lets Eliza and her niece experiment with seasonal face painting. Choose designs inspired by eggs, rabbits, flowers, butterflies or rainbows, then adjust the makeup and accessories. Finish with a hairstyle that suits the selected Easter look.

pages.title: Blocky Roads Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Blocky Roads Online gives you a vehicle to drive through hills, snowy mountains and desert dunes. Reach each finish and recover items lost when a tornado damaged the farm. Improve the vehicle as you gather what is needed to rebuild.

pages.title: Pixelo
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Pixelo turns numerical clues into pixel pictures. Work out which cells must be filled and which should stay empty to complete the hidden image. Try the daily puzzle or explore the larger collection while tracking progress and earned rewards.

pages.title: Zombie Mission 10
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Zombie Mission 10 sends you into an underground prison occupied by zombies. Fight through the stages, rescue hostages and help injured people along the route. Spend collected coins on weapons and upgrades before confronting the bosses guarding later sections.

pages.title: Unlimited Jigsaw Puzzles
pages.creator: RadDev
pages.description: Unlimited Jigsaw Puzzles offers pictures from different categories to rebuild from scattered pieces. Choose a scene and match its details to restore the full image. You can also turn one of your own device photos into a puzzle.

pages.title: Impostor Farm
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Impostor Farm asks you to grow a group of impostors using food found around the farm. Build a larger family to gain an advantage over rival groups and collect armor, speed or extra-character bonuses. Spend earned coins on improvements between attempts.

pages.title: Galactic Sniper
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Galactic Sniper puts you into two-dimensional shooting levels with a science-fiction setting. Aim at the targets presented in each stage and take the shot when the line is clear. Work through the missions by improving the accuracy of your fire.

pages.title: Bouncing Eggs
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Bouncing Eggs asks you to catch falling eggs on a cloth and bounce them toward a basket. Position the cloth to control their return path and avoid losing the next egg. Reach the collection target shown for each level.

pages.title: Ninja Star
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Ninja Star challenges you to hit balloons with a thrown shuriken. Choose the shot and send the ninja star toward the target. Adjust the next attempt according to where the previous throw traveled.

pages.title: Foody Memory
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Foody Memory hides food icons behind cards for you to pair. Reveal two pictures, remember their positions and keep finding identical partners. Clear the full board to complete a level and move on to another arrangement.

pages.title: Biryani Recipes and Super Chef Cooking Game
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Biryani Recipes and Super Chef Cooking Game turns preparing biryani into a kitchen activity. Work through steps involving rice, chicken and other ingredients, following the displayed prompts. Complete the preparation and cooking stages to put the dish together.

pages.title: Us Army Vehicles Transport Simulator
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: US Army Vehicles Transport Simulator gives you military transport assignments with pickup and drop-off points. Drive the truck along the required route and handle the load or personnel waiting for collection. Complete the delivery before moving to the next mission.

pages.title: Pin Rescue
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Pin Rescue asks you to open a safe route to a trapped friend. Move pins in the right order while keeping dangerous animals and hidden devices out of the escape path. Think through the effect of each release before continuing.

pages.title: Candy And Monsters
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Candy and Monsters is a physics puzzle about bringing monsters back to the ground. Tap candies to remove their supports and change how the remaining pieces fall. Choose an order that lowers the creatures through the arrangement successfully.

pages.title: Chained Car Stunts Race Mega Ramp GT Racing
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Chained Car Stunts Race Mega Ramp GT Racing puts linked cars on difficult stunt routes. Control the speed carefully around bends, bumps and other obstacles. Keep the connected vehicles under control so an abrupt movement does not turn the attempt into a crash.

pages.title: Math Trivia LIVE
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Math Trivia LIVE pits your calculation speed against another contestant. Answer the arithmetic questions quickly and accurately to finish with more points than the opponent. Play a human challenger or practice the quiz against a bot.

pages.title: Medieval Knights Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Medieval Knights Match 3 asks you to make groups of at least three same-colored pieces. Keep matching to build your score and stop the meter on the left from dropping too far. Look for another combination as the board changes.

pages.title: Paradise Cube
pages.creator: ingames
pages.description: Paradise Cube asks you to remove adjacent groups of two or more same-colored blocks. Meet the required totals for each color while new blocks keep falling from above. Clear useful groups before the pile reaches the top of the board.

pages.title: School Bus Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: School Bus Coloring Book lets you decorate school-bus drawings with colors of your choice. Select a picture and fill the different sections of the vehicle. Follow the familiar yellow theme or try another palette for the finished bus.

pages.title: Uphill Motorbike Rider:offroad bike Game 2020
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Uphill Motorbike Rider Offroad Bike Game 2020 puts a motorcycle on demanding mountain tracks. Steer across the rough route and keep the bike controlled around the next slope or obstacle. Complete the off-road challenges while practicing the rider's balance and speed.

pages.title: Super Cowboy Running
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Super Cowboy Running sends a cowboy through a settlement invaded by monsters and skeletons. Use the up key to jump and Space to fire while continuing along the route. Keep the rider clear of danger as you fight back against the invaders.

pages.title: Middle East Runner
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Middle East Runner takes a runner through city and subway routes filled with coins and obstacles. Move with WASD or the arrow keys to choose a safe path. Select one of four characters and try to gather more coins without a collision.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Cooking Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Cooking Time follows Hazel shopping for ingredients and preparing snacks. Help make mini quiches and a fruit wand after collecting the necessary items at the mall. Join Hazel and her pets at the table when the food is ready.

pages.title: Jeep Stunt Driving Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Jeep Stunt Driving Game puts a jeep on difficult routes built to test vehicle control. Steer through the stunt sections and handle the obstacles before the next turn. Work toward completing each level without losing control of the jeep.

pages.title: MineGame
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: MineGame gives you a block world to explore and reshape. Select building materials from the inventory, place blocks with the right mouse button and break them with the left. Move, jump and sprint to reach another area for building.

pages.title: City Duty Vehicles Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: City Duty Vehicles Jigsaw offers twelve vehicle pictures with three difficulty choices. Select a 25-, 49- or 100-piece layout and connect the scattered sections. Use the vehicles' outlines and matching background details to rebuild the complete image.

pages.title: Boxes Puzzle
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Boxes Puzzle uses breakable blocks in a physics-based arrangement. Choose which pieces to remove and account for how the remaining shapes fall. Work toward clearing the required green blocks as each removal changes the structure.

pages.title: Galactic Invaders
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Galactic Invaders puts you beneath an advancing formation of enemies. Move left or right and fire upward to destroy the attackers while avoiding their missiles. Keep the player alive as the next wave moves into position.

pages.title: Baby Halen Go To School
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Baby Halen Go to School helps Halen choose an outfit before joining her friends at school. Browse the available clothing and put together a coordinated look. Compare the pieces before completing her preparation for the day.

pages.title: Chop Slices
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Chop Slices gives you waves of fruit and vegetables to cut with a moving blade. Click to activate the cutting action and produce slices from the passing ingredients. Keep adjusting the timing as the next item reaches the blade.

pages.title: 2020 Arch KRGT1 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: 2020 Arch KRGT1 Slide offers three motorcycle pictures as sliding puzzles. Choose an image and a mode, then shift the scrambled sections into their correct positions. Plan around the available space to restore the full bike picture.

pages.title: Christmas Collection 2019
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Christmas Collection 2019 asks you to draw chains through adjacent identical gifts. Connect at least three horizontally, vertically or diagonally, then release to collect them. Make larger chains for bonuses and gather the requested presents before time runs out.

pages.title: Bus Driver 3D : Bus Driving Simulator Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Bus Driver 3D Bus Driving Simulator Game puts you on passenger routes with different buses to drive. Collect waiting travelers and bring them to their destinations, including school services. Follow the navigation while handling the large vehicle through the available driving areas.

pages.title: Babysitter
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Babysitter puts you in charge of babies through a collection of care activities. Feed, bathe and settle the children for sleep, or help them brush their teeth. Choose the next task and follow the prompts to keep each baby attended to.

pages.title: Archer Master 3D Castle Defense
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description: Archer Master 3D Castle Defense lets you practice archery before defending a fortress. Equip the bow, aim and shoot at attackers ranging from scouts and knights to fantasy creatures. Move through the defenses and complete the missions as new enemy assaults arrive.

pages.title: EG Angry Cat
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Angry Cat asks you to send a cat through rings without touching their edges. Judge each jump so the character passes cleanly through the opening. Complete the current set of rings to advance to a harder level.

pages.title: Leader War
pages.creator: 4j.com
pages.description: Leader War starts you with a small following to grow across the play area. Gather people until your group is large enough to absorb rival leaders and their followers. Keep away from stronger groups while building the numbers needed to challenge them.

pages.title: Pretty Princesses Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Pretty Princesses Jigsaw begins with one princess picture and unlocks more as you finish puzzles. Choose 25, 49 or 100 pieces for the selected image. Reconnect the character and scenery to work toward the next picture in the gallery.

pages.title: Princess Snow Wedding
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Snow Wedding helps Rachel prepare makeup and clothing for a winter celebration. Browse the dress choices and coordinate the cosmetic details with the outfit. Finish the styling before she joins the party.

pages.title: Circle Flip
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Circle Flip asks you to switch a moving ball between the two sides of its circular path. Tap to flip away from an approaching spike and keep the orbit going. React to the next hazard while building a higher score.

pages.title: Instagirls Christmas Dress Up
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Instagirls Christmas Dress Up lets you choose a character and create a festive outfit. Browse Christmas clothing, combine the pieces and prepare a holiday photograph. Try another look to change the character's finished style.

pages.title: Shape Attack
pages.creator: Enclave Games
pages.description: Shape Attack challenges you to change shape to fit the figures coming toward you. Match the approaching form to earn points and keep the attempt going. Collect enough diamonds to unlock another visual theme.

pages.title: Battleship
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Battleship asks you to place a fleet and find the computer's hidden ships before it sinks yours. Choose positions across the sea grid and use the results of each attack to narrow the search. Protect your fleet through careful placement and accurate guesses.

pages.title: The Gladiators
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: The Gladiators combines combat with connecting groups of matching elements. Link at least three symbols, choosing the type that matches the enemy's target to trigger an attack. Earn coins for hero upgrades and unlocks, using gems for additional items.

pages.title: Halloween Swipe Out
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Halloween Swipe Out fills its puzzle boards with seasonal items to match. Swipe through the pieces to make useful combinations and continue through the levels. Look at the remaining arrangement before choosing the next group.

pages.title: Color Match
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Color Match asks you to match the current ball with the target color. Compare the displayed colors and choose the matching response to continue the challenge. Keep checking the target before making another selection.

pages.title: Moms Summer Break
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Moms Summer Break helps a group of princesses choose outfits for an exotic vacation. Browse the available clothes and coordinate a look for each traveler. Finish the holiday styling before they head out to enjoy the destination.

pages.title: Super Bloody Finger Jump
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Super Bloody Finger Jump turns a finger into an arcade character trying to rise higher. Use mouse input to continue the jumps and keep the attempt alive. Work toward a better score as the climbing challenge continues.

pages.title: Asteroid Crusher
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Asteroid Crusher surrounds you with waves of asteroids to survive. Use the available weapons to destroy the approaching rocks and keep the surrounding space clear. Judge the next threat as another wave enters the belt.

pages.title: Princess Carriage Car Wash
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Princess Carriage Car Wash gives you a royal carriage to clean and decorate. Work through the washing tasks until the vehicle is ready for use, then choose design details. Finish the makeover to prepare it for the princess's next trip.

pages.title: Cave Golf
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Cave Golf brings golf into a prehistoric setting. Send the ball through the course and work out a shot that reaches the hole. Adjust the next attempt when the terrain keeps the ball from finishing where you planned.

pages.title: Tough Life Gang Land
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Tough Life Gang Land turns street encounters into a test of shooting speed and accuracy. Aim at rival gunfighters and take the shot before the confrontation gets out of hand. Keep reacting to the next target while trying to survive.

pages.title: Fast Food Bar
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Fast Food Bar puts you behind a counter preparing customer orders. Combine the available ingredients according to the recipes and deliver the requested food. Keep track of the waiting customers as you move from one dish to the next.

pages.title: Baby Ladybug Injured
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Baby Ladybug Injured follows a fictional hospital visit after Baby Ladybug hurts herself trying superhero moves. Check the displayed heartbeat and work through the wound-treatment activities. Follow the prompts to complete the little patient's recovery routine.

pages.title: Fashion Perfect MakeUp
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Fashion Perfect Makeup lets you create a cosmetic look and coordinate it with clothing. Start with foundation, choose colors for the face and finish with accessories. Compare the combinations until the makeup and outfit work together.

pages.title: Princess Birthday
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Birthday helps Lily get ready before her birthday guests arrive. Choose a dress for the celebration, then decorate the room with the available party details. Finish both parts of the preparation before the birthday gathering begins.

pages.title: Princesses Dressing Room
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Princesses Dressing Room takes you into a shared wardrobe to style two friends for an evening out. Choose a dress, matching heels and a purse for the first princess. Continue with the second character to complete both outfits.

pages.title: Princess Coronation Day
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Princess Coronation Day helps Elsa and Anna prepare for a ceremony in Arendelle. Pick dresses for the sisters and coordinate gloves, shoes and a crown with their outfits. Complete the two looks before the coronation celebration.

pages.title: Princesses Coloring Book
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Princesses Coloring Book gives you princess drawings to fill with your chosen colors. Select a picture and decorate its different sections. Continue through the pages to build a collection of completed character illustrations.

pages.title: Zombie Plague
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Zombie Plague puts you in a defensive position against approaching undead. Tap to aim while the weapon fires automatically and watch the available ammunition. Keep destroying the attackers to protect the position and increase the score.
